name: Coastal Haven
description: A bustling port city where merchant ships dock alongside fishing vessels. The smell of salt and fish permeates everything. Beyond the harbor, the drowned ruins of Ys'Thara shimmer beneath the waves.

inn.name: The Sailor's Rest
inn.description: A rowdy tavern frequented by sailors, merchants, and the occasional pirate. The ale flows freely and tales grow taller with each round.

episode_07: The ruins have been rising for weeks. Something's calling them up from the depths.
Divers say there are things down there that aren't fish, aren't human. Things that watch.
The cult ships anchor over the temple district every night. What are they bringing up?

safe_passage.description: Blessing protecting against sea creatures for 12 hours

captain_thessa.name: Captain Thessa Waveborn
captain_thessa.description: A weathered sea captain with salt-gray hair and eyes that have seen too many storms. She knows every current and reef along the coast.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to Coastal Haven. Watch your coin purse—the pickpockets here are almost as dangerous as the sharks.
dialogue.episode_07_hook: The cult's diving into the ruins. They're after something in the old Serpent Temple. I can get you down there, but it'll cost.
dialogue.after_episode_07: You stopped them. The ruins are sinking again, back to where they belong. The sea thanks you.

master_diver_kael.name: Master Diver Kael
master_diver_kael.description: A taciturn man with scars from shark bites and tentacle marks. He's been to the bottom and back more times than anyone.

dialogue.greeting: Need gear for the deep? I got it. Need advice? That costs extra.
dialogue.about_ruins: Ys'Thara wasn't just sunk—it was sealed. Something down there was too dangerous to let surface. The cult's breaking those seals.
dialogue.equipment_advice: Down there, weight is life. Bring what you need, nothing more. And trust your gills—I make the best in the business.
